raw_text: Guys has anyone seen the satellite images from Ladakh today? There are MASSIVE vehicle concentrations near the DBO area. I counted at least 200 vehicles in the Planet Labs imagery. This combined with the troop movement reports is seriously concerning. Are we looking at another Galwan situation? India seems to be preparing for something major at the LAC.
